inert_M_bitwise_matches_unlimited.criterion: at M=1e6 the WENO-limiter trajectory is bit-identical to the unlimited one

flagged_fraction_bounded_at_M1.criterion: at M=1 the flagged fraction on a resolved smooth vortex is a minority

flagged_count_monotone_in_M.criterion: flagged cell count is non-increasing in M on every mesh/degree

design_order_recovered_when_M_above_data.criterion: with M >= 10 the density EOC returns to >= 75% of the design order

forced_limiter_representation_order.criterion: a forced (M=0) WENO-limited representation converges at >= 1.9 in every field

forced_limiter_preserves_cell_average.criterion: the limiter never changes a cell average (exact conservation)

forced_limiter_flags_all_cells.criterion: M=0 flags every cell of a resolved smooth vortex
